full.description: This is a gross pathology specimen of a longitudinally opened trachea. The tissue displays marked thickening of the wall and infiltration by a tumor with areas of hemorrhage and necrosis. A ruler is visible next to the specimen for scale, demonstrating the extent of the lesion. This appearance is characteristic of a primary or metastatic malignancy involving the airway, such as small cell carcinoma of the lung with mediastinal node involvement.
